distribution.reason: Local non-FIPS candidate. Whole-image licensing, Rust runtime/source reachability, generated layers and digest-bound source delivery have not completed distribution admission.

constraints: Linux amd64/glibc 2.41; default Kryoptic features plus pqc. No FIPS build, certification or validation claim; FIPS needs a separately reviewed Fedora/static-source story.

Dynamic OpenSSL is selected through /opt/openssl/lib/pkgconfig, pinned to verified OpenSSL 4.0.2 commit f089acdf4bc7ba94a79f4bf6eb7362c3e7d14aa9. The module needs libcrypto.so.4, which is shipped; unneeded libssl.so.4 is excluded. Debian base libssl3t64 remains separately installed; ldd receipts identify usage.

Bind writable /var/lib/p11lab; init creates private kryoptic/kryoptic.conf, token.sqlite and complete. Configuration selects [[slots]], slot=1, dbtype="sqlite", dbargs="/var/lib/p11lab/kryoptic/token.sqlite". Native slot 1 is token-present index 0.

P11LAB_LABEL defaults to P11Lab, uses 1..32 ASCII letters/digits/spaces/dot/underscore/hyphen. PIN_FILE and SO_PIN_FILE are required on first init; no baked credentials. Common single-line/4096-byte secret checks run before state creation. Credentials reach provision.c over anonymous pipes, never argv, logs or markers.

Compatible repeated init ignores changed PIN files and preserves state. .init-lock, unknown/hidden files, links, missing token/config/marker and byte-different non-secret configuration are refused before a module open; never silently reset or retry.

Readiness initializes/finalizes the real local module and checks initialized-token and user-PIN flags plus label. exec preserves -- separated argv and exit status. No server/server-ready operation: this provider is a local library with no supervised process.

Serialize clients/writers to each SQLite database, including init/readiness/exec preflight; use independent state for shards and clients. Clean application C_Finalize/close and process shutdown preserve state. Reset is explicit caller removal/replacement of disposable state.

No checker, Python, tracing, datasets, OpenSC/pkcs11-tool, compiler or Rust tools in the basic runtime. Optional checker/consumer/proxy derivatives are separate artifacts. Remote use requires the compatible pinned proxy client/daemon and their documented isolation limits.

Exact provider/crate/OpenSSL sources and license texts must accompany distribution as applicable; base-package source obligations, Rust standard-library and actual-layer review remain pending. No publication authorized.
